message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) for burning straw causing forest fire. In examples, similar case: "失火" used for accidental fire causing damage. Also "失火" appears for case where person caused fire due to negligence? Example: 郭某某 case: used "失火". That was welding causing fire, not arson. Also earlier example: "放火" used for intentional arson (setting fire deliberately). Here, the person privately burned straw, causing forest fire. Likely considered "失火" (unlawful fire) or "过失放火"? Chinese criminal law: Article 115: "放火罪" (arson) includes intentional setting fire. For negligence causing fire, there is "过失火灾罪"? Actually there is "过失引发火灾罪" maybe "失火罪"? In examples they used "失火". So answer: 失火.

Check if also "破坏森林资源罪"? Not in examples. They used "失火". So final answer: [罪名]失火<eoa>.
